svg.title: The extended regions of distinct components are disjoint. Every nonzero di lies within distance B of some flag, and hence belongs to exactly one component’s sum. The assertion about distance follows from the relaxed test: outside that distance the clip condition θ exp((B −2)/crelaxation) ≥2 and the universal chord bound 2 force all its tests to be kept and healthy. Therefore P D qD = ω P i di. Assign the forced entry e−βqD(U) to the support-inventory pair (R(D), D), eligible precisely when R(D) ∩flagsθ(U) = D, and assign zero to all other active entries. In the gas sum, a nonzero admissible collection must have disjoint supports and inventories partitioning the flags. Its invento- ries are consequently exactly the connected components just described.
